name: owner_truth_changeset_proposals
summary: Adds immutable pre-review V5 ChangeSet proposals and binds terminal decision receipts to the exact Owner-visible proposal hash.
operations: create immutable changeset proposal and operation tables
add nullable paired proposal binding columns to decision receipts
enforce receipt-to-proposal consistency with a deferred foreign key
rollback: No destructive down migration. Disable V5 candidate decisions for clients that cannot bind proposals, retain proposal audit rows, and use a forward-compatible repair migration if needed.
